dialogues.jp: ｛しんしん／深々｝と桜が舞っている。
dialogues.en: The sakura petals silently flutter.
dialogues.text: The sakura petals silently flutter.

dialogues.jp: 驚くほどゆったりと。
dialogues.en: An unsurprising, calm nature to their flight.
dialogues.text: An unsurprising, calm nature to their flight.

dialogues.jp: 音もなく。
dialogues.en: Nothing can be heard.
dialogues.text: Nothing can be heard.

dialogues.jp:
天使の羽のような花びらの散りざまは、まるで
永遠を思わせる一瞬。
dialogues.en:
Like a flower's petals scattered from an angel's wings, as
if all of eternity was defined in a moment.
dialogues.text:
Like a flower's petals scattered from an angel's wings, as
if all of eternity was defined in a moment.

dialogues.jp: （ああ、俺って｛ポエマー／詩人｝）
dialogues.en: "(Aah, I'm quite the poet.)"
dialogues.text: "(Aah, I'm quite the poet.)"

dialogues.jp:
雪のように積もった桜をざくざく、と踏みしめ
ながら、ぼりぼりと頭をかく。
dialogues.en:
While stepping on the piles of snowy cherry blossoms like a
carpet of white frost, I try to take in these thoughts.
dialogues.text:
While stepping on the piles of snowy cherry blossoms like a
carpet of white frost, I try to take in these thoughts.

dialogues.jp:
（冗談はともかく、根本的にこういうシリアス
　なノリが似合わないよなぁ俺）
dialogues.en:
"(Jokes aside, a serious nature definitely doesn't suit
me.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Jokes aside, a serious nature definitely doesn't suit
me.)"

dialogues.jp:
周囲を見渡しても遠近感がぼやけていて、終わ
りというものがない世界。
dialogues.en:
Looking further into the surroundings, they seem to stretch
on forever in an endless world.
dialogues.text:
Looking further into the surroundings, they seem to stretch
on forever in an endless world.

dialogues.jp: 狂ったように桜だけが舞っている。
dialogues.en: Only the cherry trees stand out, swaying silently.
dialogues.text: Only the cherry trees stand out, swaying silently.

dialogues.jp: （誰の夢だいったい？）
dialogues.en: "(Whose dream is this?)"
dialogues.text: "(Whose dream is this?)"

dialogues.jp: 当事者が見当たらない夢も珍しい。
dialogues.en:
It's rare to see a dream without the person dreaming it
involved.
dialogues.text:
It's rare to see a dream without the person dreaming it
involved.

dialogues.jp:
自我はあるが、フラフラと文字通り夢見ごこち
で歩が進む。
dialogues.en:
I dizzily walked in a direction, as if literally in the
middle of a dream.
dialogues.text:
I dizzily walked in a direction, as if literally in the
middle of a dream.

dialogues.jp: ――他人の夢を｛・・・・・／見せられる｝。
dialogues.en: --Seeing other people's dreams.
dialogues.text: --Seeing other people's dreams.

dialogues.jp:
そんな不思議な体質をもつ俺だが、超能力者や
魔法使いみたいだなんて喜んでいられない。
dialogues.en:
I'd rather not have a power that makes me seem like a
psychic or warlock, but that's the weird power I posess.
dialogues.text:
I'd rather not have a power that makes me seem like a
psychic or warlock, but that's the weird power I posess.

dialogues.jp:
世間一般には、小説やゲームのように不思議な
力を持っている人間は、かっこいいと言われて
いる。
dialogues.en:
In the real world, someone with such a weird power normally
seen in stories or games, would certainly be thought to be
cool.
dialogues.text:
In the real world, someone with such a weird power normally
seen in stories or games, would certainly be thought to be
cool.

dialogues.jp:
どんなに辛い境遇でも、｛・・・・・／ありきたり｝よりは救い
があると――。
dialogues.en:
No matter the painful circumstances, just being normal would
be better--
dialogues.text:
No matter the painful circumstances, just being normal would
be better--

dialogues.jp: そんな｛やから／輩｝に声を大にして言いたい！
dialogues.en: That's what I wish I could shout out to everyone!
dialogues.text: That's what I wish I could shout out to everyone!

dialogues.jp: （他人の夢ほど面白くないものはないって……）
dialogues.en:
"(Other people's dreams are usually more interesting than
this...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Other people's dreams are usually more interesting than
this...)"

dialogues.jp:
意気込みはため息にしかならず、安眠妨害でし
かない世界でさまよう。
dialogues.en:
With a sigh, I continue to wander around this peaceful
world.
dialogues.text:
With a sigh, I continue to wander around this peaceful
world.

dialogues.jp: （かったるいなぁ……）
dialogues.en: "(This sucks...)"
dialogues.text: "(This sucks...)"

dialogues.jp:
夢なんてモノは元から｛しりめつれつ／支離滅裂｝なのに、他人様
の夢なんて理解不能の極みだ。
dialogues.en:
Without knowing the origins of the dream, a stranger's dream
is the height of incomprehension.
dialogues.text:
Without knowing the origins of the dream, a stranger's dream
is the height of incomprehension.

dialogues.jp:
自分の知らない人間だけで、説明不足のラブロ
マンスや、冒険物語を見せられて面白いはずも
ない。
dialogues.en:
If I don't know the person, even seeing a sordid romance or
a risky adventure isn't fun.
dialogues.text:
If I don't know the person, even seeing a sordid romance or
a risky adventure isn't fun.

dialogues.jp:
｛とっこう／徳行｝野郎Ｂチームみたいに、タイトル通りのＢ
級以下の中身だ。
dialogues.en:
It's like a B-grade movie, with a less interesting script
than usual.
dialogues.text:
It's like a B-grade movie, with a less interesting script
than usual.

dialogues.jp:
（それにしても、俺が登場してるってことは、
　知人の夢だよな）
dialogues.en:
"(Then again, my appearance here means that this has to be
the dream of someone I know.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Then again, my appearance here means that this has to be
the dream of someone I know.)"

dialogues.jp:
しかも、これだけ俺が俺でいられるということ
は、日常的に接している人物ということになる。
dialogues.en:
Furthermore, since I'm actually here, probably someone close
to me.
dialogues.text:
Furthermore, since I'm actually here, probably someone close
to me.

dialogues.jp:
（こんな｛ポエミー／詩的｝な夢を見る人物となると、それほ
　ど数は居ないから……）
dialogues.en:
"(There aren't many people around who would have this kind
of poetic dream either...)"
dialogues.text:
"(There aren't many people around who would have this kind
of poetic dream either...)"

dialogues.jp:
指折りながら、明日｛せっかん／折檻｝することになりそうな
人物を数える。
dialogues.en:
With a snap of my fingers, I could probably make it tomorrow
for both parties.
dialogues.text:
With a snap of my fingers, I could probably make it tomorrow
for both parties.

dialogues.jp:
（ふふふふふ……俺の安眠を妨害することが、
　どれほど恐ろしいか思い知らせて――）
dialogues.en:
"(Hehehe... you who would disturb my sleep, prepare to feel
my wrath--)"
dialogues.text:
"(Hehehe... you who would disturb my sleep, prepare to feel
my wrath--)"

dialogues.jp: 小指だけ立てた状態で声を失った。
dialogues.en: But as my fingers made contact, there was no sound.
dialogues.text: But as my fingers made contact, there was no sound.

dialogues.jp:
導かれるように進んでいた桜の林が｛ひら／拓｝けて、桜
の王様みたいな木が現れた。
dialogues.en:
A giant sakura tree, as if the God guiding the lessers,
materialized.
dialogues.text:
A giant sakura tree, as if the God guiding the lessers,
materialized.

dialogues.jp: （でか）

冗談を口にするが、見る者の心を揺らす不思議
な雰囲気を｛まと／纏｝っている。
dialogues.en:
As the joke flew out of my mouth, the watcher's mood swung
dramatically.
dialogues.text:
As the joke flew out of my mouth, the watcher's mood swung
dramatically.

dialogues.jp: 目の奥が熱い。
dialogues.en: My eyes feel like they're burning from within.
dialogues.text: My eyes feel like they're burning from within.

dialogues.jp:
声を失うような張り詰めた空気に、ふと、人の
気配が混じった。
dialogues.en:
My voice lost its power as the tense atmosphere mixed with
the person's mood.
dialogues.text:
My voice lost its power as the tense atmosphere mixed with
the person's mood.

dialogues.jp: あまりにも非現実的な景色に鳥肌が立つ。
dialogues.en: The surreal scene quickly gave me goosebumps.
dialogues.text: The surreal scene quickly gave me goosebumps.

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜に｛いざな／誘｝われるように、ひとりの少女が
立っていた。
dialogues.en:
The dancing sakura petals scattered to reveal the figure of
a young girl.
dialogues.text:
The dancing sakura petals scattered to reveal the figure of
a young girl.

dialogues.jp: ――その少女は、天使でなければ悪魔であろう。
dialogues.en:
--That girl, with the look of an angel, but the air of a
devil.
dialogues.text:
--That girl, with the look of an angel, but the air of a
devil.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま、お兄ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "I'm back, onii-chan..."
dialogues.text: "I'm back, onii-chan..."

dialogues.jp: 夢？
dialogues.en: A dream?
dialogues.text: A dream?

dialogues.jp: （……あぁ、そうだ。夢だったなコレは）
dialogues.en: "(...Aah, that's right. This is a dream after all.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Aah, that's right. This is a dream after all.)"

dialogues.jp:
常識的な発言が、そもそもその通りなのだと苦
笑いが浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: A bitter smile followed those words that came to mind.
dialogues.text: A bitter smile followed those words that came to mind.

dialogues.jp:
本当の名前は思い出せないけれど、こいつは幼
なじみの少女だ。
dialogues.en:
I may have forgotten her name, but I at least remember that
this girl is a childhood friend of mine.
dialogues.text:
I may have forgotten her name, but I at least remember that
this girl is a childhood friend of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「見えないけれど、そこに居るよね？」
dialogues.en: "I can't see you, are you really there?"
dialogues.text: "I can't see you, are you really there?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: （あぁ）

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うん。お兄ちゃんを感じるよ」
dialogues.en: "That's right... I can feel you here."
dialogues.text: "That's right... I can feel you here."

dialogues.jp:
思わずストライクゾーンを踏み外してしまうよ
うな、心のこもった声。
dialogues.en:
The thick voice from her heart, like someone who's
unintentionally stepped into the strike zone.
dialogues.text:
The thick voice from her heart, like someone who's
unintentionally stepped into the strike zone.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「これは夢で……多分、目が覚めたら何も覚え
　ていないだろうけど……」
dialogues.en:
"If this is a dream... then maybe, when we wake up, we won't
remember anything..."
dialogues.text:
"If this is a dream... then maybe, when we wake up, we won't
remember anything..."

dialogues.jp: 少女の曇った顔を見るだけで心が痛む。
dialogues.en: The girl's sad face tugged at my heartstrings.
dialogues.text: The girl's sad face tugged at my heartstrings.

dialogues.jp:
しかし手を伸ばすことも、抱きしめてやること
も、声をかけてやることすら出来ない……。
dialogues.en:
But stretching out my hand, hugging her, or even calling
out, are things I can't do now...
dialogues.text:
But stretching out my hand, hugging her, or even calling
out, are things I can't do now...

dialogues.jp:
――決められた夢を見るだけの、
　　　　　　　　出来そこないの魔法使い――
dialogues.en:
--Because I'm just a bystander, who can do nothing but watch
this unchangeable dream.--
dialogues.text:
--Because I'm just a bystander, who can do nothing but watch
this unchangeable dream.--

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「約束を思い出して」
dialogues.en: "Remember our promise."
dialogues.text: "Remember our promise."

dialogues.jp: それは、そう……。
dialogues.en: That is, that's right...
dialogues.text: That is, that's right...

dialogues.jp: 冬の終わりと、春の訪れを迎える前の夢。
dialogues.en:
The dream after the end of winter, but before the start of
spring.
dialogues.text:
The dream after the end of winter, but before the start of
spring.

dialogues.jp:
この時点では意味のない――ダ・カーポのよう
な、はじまりと終わりの夢。
dialogues.en:
The point of time with no significance--Da Capo, the
beginning and ending of the dream.
dialogues.text:
The point of time with no significance--Da Capo, the
beginning and ending of the dream.

dialogues.jp: ◆夢の始まり◆
dialogues.en: ◆The beginning of the dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆The beginning of the dream◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見せられていた。
dialogues.en: I was viewing a dream.
dialogues.text: I was viewing a dream.

dialogues.jp:
誰の見ている夢なのだろう？　俺が知っている
人物が見ているらしいが……。
dialogues.en: Whose dream was it? It has to be someone who I know...
dialogues.text: Whose dream was it? It has to be someone who I know...

dialogues.jp:
……幼なじみの少女。曇りを帯びた表情で、彼
女はこう言った。
dialogues.en:
...A small girl, my old childhood friend. With a cloudy
expression, the girl spoke softly.
dialogues.text:
...A small girl, my old childhood friend. With a cloudy
expression, the girl spoke softly.

dialogues.jp: 約束を思い出して。
dialogues.en: Remember the promise.
dialogues.text: Remember the promise.

dialogues.jp: それは、そう……。
dialogues.en: That is, that's right...
dialogues.text: That is, that's right...

dialogues.jp: 冬の終わりと、春の訪れを迎える前の夢。
dialogues.en:
The dream after the end of winter, but before the start of
spring.
dialogues.text:
The dream after the end of winter, but before the start of
spring.

dialogues.jp:
この時点では意味のない――ダ・カーポのよう
な、はじまりと終わりの夢。
dialogues.en:
The point of time with no significance--Da Capo, the
beginning and ending of the dream.
dialogues.text:
The point of time with no significance--Da Capo, the
beginning and ending of the dream.
